holdout_screen: Train co-occurrence >=30, holdout co-occurrence >=20, train and holdout lift >=1.5. Exploratory screen, not statistical significance or causal uplift.
basket_universe: All positive merchandise-candidate invoices in each period; SKU universe top 100 selected exclusively in training.
invoice_period_assignment: Earliest positive merchandise line date per invoice.
caveat: Temporal holdout shares the same retailer and changing assortment; no inventory, prices, margins or treatment outcomes.
